seoTitle: Vikings Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Vikings test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Ragnar, Lagertha, Rollo, Floki, Bjorn, Athelstan, Ecbert, Ivar or Ubbe — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the curious legend, the fearless shieldmaiden, or the brother tired of living in someone's shadow? Answer 12 everyday questions about loyalty, ambition and adventure, and find out which Vikings character you are.

characters.name: Ragnar Lothbrok
characters.title: The Legend
characters.summary: Curious, clever and always one step ahead. You're hungry to see what's out there, and nobody ever quite knows your next move.
description: Like Ragnar, you're endlessly curious. He starts out as a farmer, and he's eager to learn about other cultures.
You rise from nothing. Ragnar becomes Earl of Kattegat, raids England and Paris, and eventually becomes king.
You become a legend. Ragnar is thrown into a pit of snakes by King Aelle, and his sons set out to avenge him.
characters.flaw: You keep your plans so secret that even the people closest to you feel shut out.
characters.signature: A quiet smile, a restless mind and a plan nobody saw coming.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep their plans to themselves, then surprise you with them

characters.name: Lagertha
characters.title: The Shieldmaiden
characters.summary: Strong, independent and impossible to push around. You make your own way, and you never let anyone disrespect you.
description: Like Lagertha, you're fiercely independent. She's a shieldmaiden, and Ragnar's first wife.
You make your own way. Lagertha becomes Earl of Hedeby in her own right.
You don't forget a wrong. Lagertha kills Aslaug, and takes her place as ruler of Kattegat.
characters.flaw: You can hold on to a grudge for a very long time.
characters.signature: A shield, a steady gaze and a backbone of steel.
characters.clashReason: they'd never let you get away with disrespecting them

characters.name: Rollo
characters.title: The Brother
characters.summary: Strong, bold and hungry for your own glory. You're tired of living in someone else's shadow, and you'll go your own way to get out of it.
description: Like Rollo, you're a force to be reckoned with. He's Ragnar's brother, and a skilled warrior.
You want your own glory. Rollo grows to resent living in Ragnar's shadow.
You build your own kingdom. Rollo joins the Franks, and becomes Duke of Normandy.
characters.flaw: You measure yourself against others, and it eats you up.
characters.signature: A big laugh, a strong arm and a score to settle.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn everything into a competition with you

characters.name: Floki
characters.title: The Eccentric
characters.summary: Creative, devout and completely one of a kind. You follow your instincts and your faith, and you laugh at anyone who doubts you.
description: Like Floki, you're one of a kind. He's eccentric and devout, and he believes he's descended from the god Loki.
You're brilliant with your hands. Floki is a gifted shipbuilder whose designs transform shipbuilding.
You follow your faith. Floki leads a group of settlers to a new land.
characters.flaw: You trust your instincts so much that you won't listen to anyone else.
characters.signature: A wild laugh, a half-built ship and a prayer to the gods.
characters.clashReason: they'd laugh at the worst possible moment

characters.name: Bjorn Ironside
characters.title: The Explorer
characters.summary: Adventurous, brave and determined to make your own name. You want to go further than anyone before you.
description: Like Bjorn, you want to make your own name. He's Ragnar and Lagertha's son, known as Bjorn Ironside.
You go further than anyone. Bjorn's travels take him as far as North Africa.
You honour your family. Bjorn avenges his father by executing King Aelle, and later becomes king of Kattegat.
characters.flaw: You're so busy living up to someone else's legend that you forget to write your own.
characters.signature: A map, a boat and a horizon you haven't crossed yet.
characters.clashReason: they'd always be off on their next adventure, without you

characters.name: Athelstan
characters.title: The Monk
characters.summary: Gentle, thoughtful and open-minded. You see the good in different ways of life, even when it leaves you torn.
description: Like Athelstan, you're thoughtful and gentle. He's a monk from Lindisfarne who's captured on Ragnar's very first raid.
You're open to new ways. Athelstan grows to appreciate Viking culture.
You see both sides. Athelstan is torn between Christian and pagan ways, and he becomes a confidant of King Ecbert.
characters.flaw: You're so torn between two paths that you struggle to choose one.
characters.signature: A worn book, a quiet prayer and an open mind.
characters.clashReason: they'd see both sides, even when you want them on yours

characters.name: King Ecbert
characters.title: The Schemer
characters.summary: Charming, cultured and always working an angle. You make friends easily, and you never stop thinking about what they can do for you.
description: Like Ecbert, you're ambitious and charming. He's an English king who dreams of becoming Bretwalda, ruler over the other English kingdoms.
You make unlikely friends. Ecbert becomes a friend of Ragnar, even though they're on opposite sides.
You keep clever people close. Ecbert makes Athelstan his confidant.
characters.flaw: You always have a hidden motive, even with your friends.
characters.signature: A charming smile, an elegant room and a scheme in progress.
characters.clashReason: they'd charm you, then use you

characters.name: Ivar the Boneless
characters.title: The Mastermind
characters.summary: Clever, determined and desperate to prove yourself. You hate being underestimated, and you'll stop at nothing to come out on top.
description: Like Ivar, you're determined to prove yourself. He's the son of Ragnar and Aslaug, known as Ivar the Boneless.
You hate being underestimated. Ivar is deeply insecure, and he wants everyone to see how much he matters.
You rise to the top. With help from Harald and Rollo, Ivar becomes king of Kattegat.
characters.flaw: You need to be admired, and you can't stand being told no.
characters.signature: A sharp mind, a cold smile and a point to prove.
characters.clashReason: they'd take every disagreement as a personal attack

characters.name: Ubbe
characters.title: The Peacemaker
characters.summary: Responsible, fair and calm under pressure. You'd rather protect what you have than chase glory, and you're the one who keeps the peace.
description: Like Ubbe, you're the responsible one. He's the most responsible of Aslaug's sons, and he'd rather protect Kattegat than go raiding.
You build bridges. Ubbe becomes an advisor to King Alfred, and converts to Christianity.
You find what you were looking for. In the finale, Ubbe discovers the Golden Land, with Floki.
characters.flaw: You try so hard to keep the peace that you avoid the fights worth having.
characters.signature: A steady hand, a fair deal and a home worth protecting.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you to calm down and talk it through

questions.text: You get the chance to travel somewhere nobody you know has ever been. You...

options.text: Pack right away, and learn everything you can about the people there
Go, and try to get further than anyone before you
Stay. Someone has to look after things at home
Wait for a sign that it's meant to be

questions.text: Someone close to you always gets all the credit. You...

options.text: Stew about it, until it turns into a grudge
Plan how you'll prove you're better than them
Work twice as hard to make your own name
Feel happy for them. Credit doesn't matter much to you
Building something with your own hands, all by yourself
Reading somewhere quiet and peaceful
A fine meal and clever conversation
A big feast, loud friends and maybe a fight

questions.text: Someone disrespects you in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Put them in their place, right there
Smile, and make them regret it later
Stay calm. You'll outsmart them when it matters
Let it go. It's not worth starting a war over

questions.text: You're put in charge of a group for the first time. You...

options.text: Lead from the front, and earn their respect
Charm everyone, and quietly line up your next move
Make sure nobody ever forgets who's in charge
Make sure everyone's looked after first

questions.text: Someone invites you to try a completely different way of life. You...

options.text: Give it a real chance, even if it changes you
Refuse. You'll stay true to what you believe
Ask a hundred questions about it first
Try it, if it gets you ahead

questions.text: A big decision needs making, and everyone's arguing. You...

options.text: Listen to all of them, then do something nobody expected
Do the sensible thing, even if nobody's excited about it
Make the call yourself, and stand by it
Laugh, and let them argue it out

questions.text: A rival offers you a better deal than the people you've worked with for years. You...

options.text: Take it. It's time you got what you deserve
Say you'll think about it, and see who offers more
Turn it down. Loyalty matters more than money
Feel torn, and take ages to decide

questions.text: You make something you're really proud of. You...

options.text: Show it off to everyone who doubted you
Find a way to make it pay off for you
Feel quietly grateful, and keep it to yourself
Start on something even bigger

questions.text: A friend you trusted betrays you. You...

options.text: Never forget it, and get even when the time is right
Forgive them, but never trust them the same way again
Talk it out, and try to save the friendship
Act like it doesn't hurt, then turn on them without warning

questions.text: You lead a group of settlers, and a powerful king offers you land if you live peacefully in his country. You...

options.text: Accept. Peace and good farmland are worth more than glory
Accept, and make yourself one of them
Agree, and keep your options open
Refuse. You didn't come all this way to farm

questions.text: You're a king, and a foreign leader arrives at your border with an army. You...

options.text: Welcome them warmly, and look for a way to use them
Meet them on the battlefield. Nobody threatens your home
Try to bring both sides together
Pretend to make peace, then strike when they least expect it
